placements.title: the test artifact that declares the behavior it simultaneously embodies
placements.frame: How does a probe artifact function as both the declaration of an expected system rule and the instance that instantiates it?
placements.why: Both expressions perform the same theme: src-1 declares the enrollment rule the e2e suite asserts, and src-2 instrumentalizes the probe memory as the vehicle carrying that assertion. The artifact is simultaneously the declaration and the embodiment of the behavior it validates — a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding. No existing leaf holds this.
